text:
the patio, in his trinchera of alambres and cordeles,

goza the paz, templada of sol, of the mediodía.

Advierto in their rincones arrugados papeles,

montones of botellas, tirada trapería.


Soleados, orondos, maduros, dilatados,

irrumpen the tomates, irrumpen the pimientos.

Junto a the acentuados verdes, the encarnados

apuntan, with vigores sumos, their ardimientos.


the aire is satura of the olor of the tinas;

and, adueñados of the simple, doméstico recinto,

his copula efectúan the gallo and the gallinas

in the desbordamientos vitales of the instinto.


In detalles that indican simplicidad, abunda

the patio. Muy gozosa of his life ligera,

of his life that is life llameante and fecunda,

descubre allí their frutos colosales the higuera.
